race.description: Laurel Oak Supporter Of NJT Hcp (Bm78)
race.comment: ERNAUX (3) starting to put it together deep into the prep and races best on the firmer tracks. Nailed late by the progressive Sovereign Hill when second over 1200m here last start. No excuses from the draw and has genuine top three claims. TEQUILA BABY (5) indicated she was back to her best with a closing third over 1100m at Warwick Farm in weaker company. Senior rider engaged and will appreciate the good surface. SCILLATO (6) resumed for the Matt Smith yard with an encouraging sixth from back in the field over 1000m at Warwick Farm. Raced with distinction at stakes level and her best form is over this trip. Gets the right run today and has each way prospects. SCENIC POINT (9) resumes, and now in the Joe Pride stable. Has looked airborne in the two trial wins and was a Listed winner last year. Forward showing expected. WRITTEN SCANDAL (11) blinkers go on fifth up and is a must for the exotics.
